instruction: Learning annex conversion from init.ifc. Open the provided C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in Archicad. Use C:\Users\user\Desktop\init_plan.png and C:\Users\user\Desktop\init_section.png as references, then convert the model into the required two-storey learning annex. The init model is a starting shell and must be updated where it lacks the required final elements. Save an IFC4 export to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc and a tab-delimited zone schedule to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.txt. Keep the shaped building envelope approximately within min 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 and max 18.0, 8.0, 6.6, with 0.5 m tolerance. The IFC must contain unique GlobalId values, exactly two building storeys, exactly eight IfcSpace zones, at least eight walls, at least two slabs, and at least two roofs. On the lower storey create Z01 CLASSROOM-1 24.0 m2, Z02 CLASSROOM-2 24.0 m2, Z03 PLAY-HALL 48.0 m2, Z04 STAFF 8.0 m2, Z05 WC-CHILD 4.0 m2, and Z06 WC-STAFF 4.0 m2. On the upper storey create Z07 CLASSROOM-3 24.0 m2 and Z08 CLASSROOM-4 24.0 m2. The schedule must use headers ZoneNumber, ZoneName, Area, list those rows in order, keep each area within +/-0.10 m2, and total between 159.0 and 161.0 m2. Equivalent Archicad or IFC export internals, object names, relationship structure, materials, and property sets may vary; the required result is the stated BIM model and deliverables, not a byte-for-byte copy of the teacher IFC. [Software] Launch ArchiCAD with `C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad` (adjust version/path).
